meta.what: Recorded output of the four groupPointsByBucket consumers (aggregateLineSeries, aggregateSumSeries, aggregateOHLCV, aggregateEnvelope) across all three resolutions.
meta.capturedFrom: LibreFolio commit eba37ba41, BEFORE the groupPointsByBucket parameter refactor. These numbers are an artefact of the old implementation, not of the current one.
meta.why: An identity test written after a refactor compares the new code against itself and passes forever while proving nothing. Recording the pre-refactor behaviour makes the post-refactor assertion a real comparison against a frozen record.
meta.doNotEdit: Never hand-edit a value here. Change the inputs in timeSeriesAggregationGoldenCases.ts, or re-record with regenerateTimeSeriesAggregationGolden.ts and then update GOLDEN_DIGEST in timeSeriesAggregationGolden.test.ts by hand, in the same commit, having read the drift the script prints.
